neighbours.label: The head nouns power and function after electrical and kidney in descriptions of impairment.
fire: The damaged cable interrupted the supply of electrical power.
The flood caused a prolonged loss of electrical power at the station.
The pump stopped because electrical power was unavailable.
The engineer traced the failure to a drop in electrical power.
The blood test indicated a decline in kidney function.
The patient was monitored for reduced kidney function.
The infection caused a gradual loss of kidney function.
The report linked fatigue to impaired kidney function.
quiet: The damaged cable interrupted the supply of electricity.
The flood caused a prolonged loss of electricity at the station.
The pump stopped because electricity was unavailable.
The engineer traced the failure to a drop in the electricity supply.
The blood test indicated that the kidneys were working less effectively.
The patient was monitored for reduced efficiency of the kidneys.
The infection caused the kidneys to work progressively less well.
The report linked fatigue to poor performance of the kidneys.

notes: Broad card includes electrical power and kidney function. Exploration supported these two local phrases; this is not a claim about impairment in general. Controls keep the impairment topic and paraphrase the noun phrase. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory sentences are disjoint from this preregistered test.
